purpose: durable live production telemetry with open-source observability backends

github_issue.role: always-on durable fallback for GitHub Actions live retrieval

opentelemetry_collector.role: vendor-neutral metrics/traces/log transport when a collector endpoint is provisioned
opentelemetry_collector.promotion_gate: real EP01 run reaches collector and metrics can be queried independently of GitHub Actions logs

prometheus_pushgateway.promotion_gate: real EP01 run pushes measured progress and stale series lifecycle is verified

rules: The production progress ledger remains canonical; external telemetry is a mirror, never the source of truth.
No percentage, rate, or ETA may be fabricated from wall-clock time alone.
Missing telemetry is UNKNOWN and triggers bounded recovery rather than healthy RUNNING.
Telemetry publishing must never block or cancel a healthy production process.
GitHub Actions log availability must never be treated as the only live-observability channel.
